The prototype is ready for you to try. Open it here:

**http://maker:4001**

**This is flow 1 — saving a link.** Please do this one action:

1. Click the box at the top and paste (or type) any link you'd actually want to keep — for example `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bookmark`.
2. Press **Save link**.

Then tell me what you think of what happens.

A few things I decided that I'd like you to react to as well:

- **What the main view shows right now** is a single "Recent" list, newest at the top. I set it up so the link you just saved jumps to the very top.
- **Each saved item shows three things**: a title, the web address underneath, and when it was saved. Since you only gave a link (not a title), I *guessed a title automatically from the address*. Please look at whether that auto-guessed title is good enough, or whether you'd want to type your own title when saving.
- Before you save anything, the list shows an **empty "nothing saved yet" message** — check whether that feels right for a fresh start.

Operate it and let me know: does saving a link, and seeing it appear this way, match what you had in mind?
